Essay Evaluation Guide for July.
Please note the following guideline for the essay evaluation for July.
1st grade
- Lower level(Uma, Leo): minimum 10 sentences
- All students are to
1) follow [introduction - body - conclusion] format
2) suggest at least two evidences for the argument
3) use Various verbs Tense(past-present-future tense), Adjective clauses (N to-v, N ving, N pp)

다양한 시제의 동사 사용 : 과거, 현재, 미래 시제
